# Matrix targets expand over one key, several keys as a cartesian product,
# and keys computed from earlier ones.
bit --plan ...
stdout '^binary\["amd64"\] \+'
stdout '^binary\["arm64"\] \+'
stdout '^cross\["darwin", "amd64"\] \+'
stdout '^cross\["darwin", "arm64"\] \+'
stdout '^cross\["linux", "amd64"\] \+'
stdout '^cross\["linux", "arm64"\] \+'
stdout '^nested\["linux", "linux-a"\] \+'
stdout '^nested\["darwin", "darwin-b"\] \+'
! stdout 'nested\["linux", "darwin'

# A string key may be unquoted on the command line, and selects one slice.
bit 'binary[arm64]'
stdout 'binary\["arm64"\] ✔'
! stdout 'amd64'
grep '\Aarm64\z' bin-arm64
! exists bin-amd64

! bit 'binary[riscv]'
stderr 'unknown target: binary\[riscv\]'

# A slice depends on the matching slice of the matrix target it references,
# whether indexed by key or not.
bit 'package[amd64]' 'implicit[arm64]'
stdout 'binary\["amd64"\] ✔'
stdout 'binary\["arm64"\] · no changes'
grep '\Aamd64\z' pkg-amd64
grep '\Aarm64\z' imp-arm64
! exists pkg-arm64

# A non-matrix target depending on a matrix target waits for every slice.
bit --graph all
stdout 'binary\["amd64"\]'
stdout 'binary\["arm64"\]'

# Arguments configure an instance of the whole matrix; keys select slices.
bit release arm
stdout 'tagged\["amd64"\]\(tag="v1"\) ✔'
stdout 'tagged\["arm64"\]\(tag="v1"\) ✔'
stdout 'tagged\["arm64"\]\(tag="v2"\) ✔'
! stdout 'tagged\["amd64"\]\(tag="v2"\)'
exists t-amd64-v1 t-arm64-v1 t-arm64-v2
! exists t-amd64-v2

# concurrency = 1 runs one slice at a time.
bit serial
! grep 'start.*\nstart' serial.log
grep 'end 1' serial.log
grep 'end 3' serial.log

-- BUILD.bit --
let arch = ["amd64", "arm64"]
let os = ["linux", "darwin"]

binary[arch] = exec {
  command = "printf #{arch} > bin-#{arch}"
  outputs = "bin-#{arch}"
}

package[arch] = exec {
  command = "cp #{binary[arch].path} pkg-#{arch}"
  outputs = "pkg-#{arch}"
}

implicit[arch] = exec {
  command = "cp #{binary.path} imp-#{arch}"
  outputs = "imp-#{arch}"
}

cross[os, arch] = exec {
  command = "printf x > cross-#{os}-#{arch}"
  outputs = "cross-#{os}-#{arch}"
}

nested[os, file = ["#{os}-a", "#{os}-b"]] = exec {
  command = "printf #{os} > n-#{file}"
  outputs = "n-#{file}"
}

tagged[arch](tag : string) = exec {
  command = "printf #{tag} > t-#{arch}-#{tag}"
  outputs = "t-#{arch}-#{tag}"
}

serial[n = [1, 2, 3]] = exec {
  concurrency = 1
  command = "echo start #{n} >> serial.log; sleep 0.2; echo end #{n} >> serial.log"
  inputs = []
}

all = exec {
  command = "true"
  depends_on = [binary]
}

group release = [tagged(tag = "v1")]
group arm = [tagged["arm64"](tag = "v2")]
